notes: Adds Brand-scoped reusable destination groups without granting group-level approval or publishing authority.
Expands group selections into the existing VS-30 concrete destination distribution contract.
Each expanded destination still receives independent approval, capability validation, idempotency and PublishCommand state.
Adds migration 0018 for group metadata only; no production migration execution is authorized by this slice.
No new social provider, OAuth scope, provider credential flow, autonomous scheduler, deployment or real publication is introduced.

approvals.rationale: Owner approved VS-32 certification and merge, then explicitly instructed Go next into roadmap item #5 Channel / Account Groups under the existing standing implementation authorization.
The slice is a reusable selection layer over already-approved FR-05/FR-10/FR-13/FR-15 behavior and preserves per-destination human approval and deterministic publication controls.
Standing implementation pre-approval covers code, tests, CI fixes, UI review and PR preparation; certification, merge, release and production enablement remain exact-SHA gates.
Requires deterministic evidence and explicit approval bound to the final exact candidate SHA.
Separate exact-SHA release approval is required.
Separate exact-SHA production-enable approval is required.

postRelease.expectedOutcome: Users can save and reuse Brand-scoped channel-account sets while all external destinations remain independently approved and auditable.
